plugins.name: Figma
plugins.purpose: Read exact Figma nodes, implement designs and motion, write back when requested.
plugins.restore: Install the official Figma plugin in the destination app, connect the account and confirm access to the requested file. Do not install these skill names separately over the plugin.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.purpose: Read and publish repositories, verify remote commits.
plugins.restore: Install/connect GitHub in the destination app and authorize the required repositories.

plugins.name: Browser
plugins.purpose: Inspect localhost and verify visual behavior.
plugins.restore: Use the browser tooling provided by the destination app. Internal transports are not portable.

plugins.name: Computer Use
plugins.purpose: Native UI interaction when an API does not cover the task.
plugins.restore: Install/enable the official plugin if the destination OS and app support it.

plugins.name: Visualize
plugins.purpose: Inline interactive design and motion explanations.
plugins.restore: Install/enable the official plugin if available.

plugins.name: Code Review
plugins.restore: Enable in the destination app if available.
